name: Falla Sagewind
summary: Falla Sagewind is a reclusive tauren mystic perched high upon a rocky peak overlooking the central Barrens. Stationed between the Crossroads and the Lushwater Oasis, she studies the natural and mystical anomalies troubling the surrounding land. Adventurers probing the twisted corruption seeping from the nearby Wailing Caverns often seek her guidance.

sections.title: Watcher of the High Crag
sections.body: Falla Sagewind makes her camp far above the dust and bustle of the Barrens trails, situated on a secluded summit just southwest of the Crossroads. From this vantage, she keeps a solemn watch over the fragile savannas below, observing the sudden shifts in wildlife behavior and the encroaching corruption rising from the subterranean fissures of the Wailing Caverns. Her solitary vigil separates her from the daily trade of the Crossroads, positioning her as an observant hermit tuned to the spirits and the land's silent wounds.

sections.title: The Waking Nightmare
sections.body: When strange, pulsating shards are pulled from the mutated beasts of the Barrens, wise travelers are directed to climb the crags toward Falla. She aids in interpreting the twisted magics unraveling the natural order of the oases. Recognizing the grim signs of the Emerald Dream turning foul beneath the earth, she sends heroes to the wise druids of the Cenarion Circle for deeper answers about the nightmare taking root within the region.

faq.answer: Falla Sagewind is a solitary tauren mystic residing on a high cliff southwest of the Crossroads in the Barrens. She watches over the land and assists travelers seeking to understand the strange magical afflictions spreading across the region.

faq.q: Where can I find Falla Sagewind?
faq.answer: She is located atop a steep mountain peak directly southwest of the Crossroads and north of the Lushwater Oasis. Reaching her camp requires winding up the rocky pathways ascending from the surrounding savanna.

faq.q: Why is Falla Sagewind interested in the Wailing Caverns?
aliases: why does falla care about the oasis
faq.answer: Falla monitors the balance of nature in the Barrens. When adventurers bring her a glowing shard taken from the depths of the Wailing Caverns, she recognizes it as an essence of the Emerald Dream turned to nightmare and urges them to deliver it to a wise druid.

faq.q: Is Falla Sagewind affiliated with any clan or family?
faq.answer: She carries the Sagewind surname, a name associated with other notable tauren such as Hunter Sagewind and Tahu Sagewind. While a familial connection is likely given tauren naming traditions, she keeps mostly to herself upon her overlook.

Falla is involved in the investigations surrounding the Wailing Caverns, notably turning in or continuing quests like The Glowing Shard and In Nightmares, which delve into the dark dream corrupting the local oases.

faq.q: Can Alliance players interact with Falla Sagewind?
faq.answer: Yes. Falla helps travelers of both factions with the Glowing Shard, sending Alliance adventurers to Mathrengyl Bearwalker in Darnassus and Horde adventurers to Hamuul Runetotem in Thunder Bluff.

angles.text: Falla Sagewind exemplifies the tauren duty of quiet stewardship over the earth, watching for spiritual rot from high places while her brethren defend the roads below.
Druids will recognize Falla as a crucial ally in tracking down the tragic descent of Naralex and the Druids of the Fang within the Wailing Caverns.
Falla aids the Horde by interpreting strange omens and corrupted relics brought back by scouts from the contested savannas of the Barrens.
